claim: Seasonal source-class area fell by 25.42% between 2000 and 2021 on the 1276.41 km2 common-observation footprint.
scope_limit: Source-class endpoint difference, not error-adjusted true water extent or whole administrative district area.

claim: The negative annual seasonal-class time coefficient in Naogaon and Rajshahi remains in the exploratory observation-effort and 2016 asset-boundary specification.
scope_limit: Conditional exploratory association, n=22 annual records; not causal pumping attribution. Seasonal prediction does not improve mean CV RMSE over its training-mean benchmark.

claim: The permanent-class endpoint increase establishes a robust continuing physical-water increase.
scope_limit: All permanent time-coefficient intervals include zero after the 2016-boundary sensitivity. A boundary control can absorb real hydrological steps too.

claim: Both Rajshahi baseline-seasonal radar-envelope endpoint time coefficients are positive in the specified 2015-2024 exploratory models.
scope_limit: Logit method-envelope fraction/year, n=90. Different period, support, class cohort and sensor than the primary annual analysis; not true-water area or causal effect.

claim: The four fixed DW threshold comparisons exhibit increasing conditional SAR/DW agreement alongside decreasing paired footprint.
scope_limit: No threshold was selected. The denominator is paired area-month, with shared optical dependence and SAR classification error remaining.

claim: The final 720-point comparison retains all unknowns and quantifies conditional proxy agreement plus a binary-completion range.
scope_limit: Four frozen months only; assisted labels are selected, automatic labels are heuristic, ranges are not physical-accuracy intervals.

claim: Code-generated or model-assisted labels establish representative independent water-classification accuracy.
scope_limit: No separate representative independent references exist. No accuracy percentage is certified; the manual protocol was not silently relaxed.

claim: The available observations identify a reliable time to water recovery after drought.
scope_limit: All 108 primary event-cohort records and all nine sensitivity specifications lack identifiable duration. This is not no recovery or zero recovery time.
